title: Quite good and great for the price!
text: Quite good and great for the price!. Soft and for being to soft and delicate and I mean almost paper thin they do dry quite well, the only thing is that obviously they are do absorb extremely well so they get wet faster and harder to manipulate but overall I like the softness and don't really mind it unless you plan to use them for something else than drying your hands or the dishes I'd say these are definitely great, super soft on everything and very easy to use!
